description: Get aggregated quality scores for a service based on past verifications and reports, counting each paying wallet once (its latest). Returns the pass rate (overall, and over the rows where code checked the format or a measured time), average completeness and accuracy over the scored rows with their count, the count of inconclusive rows, format and SLA compliance rates, and a trend by pass rate. The scores are self-reported by paying wallets and not attested: nothing proves a reporter used the service.
name: get_service_quality
